name: Lohia Corp Ltd
tagline: Recently-listed global leader (15.4% share) in woven-Raffia/technical-textile machinery, with an order book that has doubled YoY (Rs 1,778 Cr), genuine margin-driven Q1 FY27 profit growth (+292% YoY, EBITDA margin +840bps), declining debt and operating cash flow that EXCEEDS net profit (1.68x in FY26) - this pass resolves the valuation question the original write-up left open (P/E ~24.3x) and finds a clean, high-quality picture, a real contrast to several other names reviewed this batch.
business_overview: Lohia Corp (formerly Kanpur Packaging Machines Limited, restructured via an NCLT scheme in 2024) manufactures machinery for the technical textiles industry, focused on polypropylene (PP)/HDPE woven Raffia fabric and sack production, exporting to ~100 countries (41% of Q1 FY27 revenue). Per the F&S Report cited in IPO materials, it held 15.4% of the global woven-Raffia machinery market by value in 2024. Listed NSE/BSE 30 July 2026; promoters retained 75.24% post-IPO (down from 95.61% pre-IPO, standard IPO dilution). Seeded via untrusted X triage (@nid_rockz, bullish/very-high conviction, 2026-09-13).

ROE ~37-45%; ROCE ~44% - consistent across BOTH FY25 and FY26 (pre-dating the IPO), not a one-off

~Rs 1,778 Cr (Jun 2026), nearly double the Rs 910 Cr a year earlier; exports ~30% of order book, ~41% of Q1 FY27 revenue
Borrowings declining: Rs 237 Cr (Mar 2025) -> Rs 175 Cr (Mar 2026), -26%; D/E ~0.23
Operating cash flow Rs 325 Cr EXCEEDS net profit Rs 193 Cr (1.68x); free cash flow Rs 294 Cr, up from Rs 108 Cr FY25 - genuine, strong cash generation
fundamentals_narrative: This deep-dive pass resolves the central open question the original write-up flagged ('no forward P/E or broker consensus was surfaced... the entry-valuation question is unresolved') and finds a genuinely clean, high-quality picture: P/E is ~24.3x, not extreme for a business with ROCE consistently at ~44% across BOTH FY25 and FY26 (i.e. this predates the IPO re-rating and isn't a one-quarter phenomenon), declining absolute debt (Rs 237 Cr -> Rs 175 Cr), and - most importantly - operating cash flow that EXCEEDS net profit (Rs 325 Cr OCF vs Rs 193 Cr PAT in FY26, a 1.68x ratio, up from 1.19x in FY25). This is a direct, favourable contrast to several other names reviewed in this pass's batch that showed profit unbacked by cash. Q1 FY27's 292% YoY profit jump is aided by a low base, but is also genuinely margin-driven (EBITDA margin +840bps YoY to 19.9% on higher volumes and operating leverage), not purely a base-effect illusion. The order book has doubled YoY to Rs 1,778 Cr with a broad, ~100-country export footprint (41% of revenue). The company underwent an NCLT restructuring scheme in 2024 (details not independently investigated this pass) before its July 2026 IPO, which limits how far back a clean historical comparison can go, but the two years of data available (FY25, FY26) are consistently strong rather than a one-off.
technical_read: Trading near its 52-week high (Rs 555.60, currently ~Rs 545) as of mid-Sep 2026 - a new one-year-high on strong Q1 FY27 results, i.e. already re-rated post-IPO rather than sitting at an undiscovered valuation, though this pass shows the re-rating is reasonably supported by fundamentals rather than purely sentiment-driven.
sentiment_summary: No ValuePickr thread resolved this pass (very recent listing, July 2026, re-confirmed); fast fundamentals/filings-based write-up only.
bse_notes: No red flags found this pass either - no negative net worth, no SEBI action, no auditor resignation, no promoter-pledge issue. The 2024 NCLT restructuring scheme (pre-IPO, formerly Kanpur Packaging Machines Limited) was noted but not independently investigated - flagged as an open question rather than a concern, since NCLT schemes are routine for pre-IPO group restructuring.

ROCE has been consistently ~44% across BOTH FY25 and FY26 (pre-dating the IPO re-rating) - not a one-off, and operating cash flow EXCEEDS net profit (1.68x FY26) - a genuinely high-quality, cash-generative business, a favourable contrast to several other names in this batch

Order book has doubled YoY (Rs 1,778 Cr) with strong export mix (41% of revenue, ~100 countries) giving multi-quarter revenue visibility; Q1 FY27 margin expansion (+840bps) shows genuine operating leverage, not just a low base

verdict_headline: A genuinely high-quality, cash-generative global niche machinery leader - this pass resolves the valuation question left open originally (P/E ~24.3x, not demanding) and confirms 2 consecutive years of ~44% ROCE plus operating cash flow exceeding profit. Conviction reaffirmed Medium-High; thesis stays 'neither' - not on valuation concerns (now resolved favourably) but because the size/return-magnitude math doesn't support a literal 10x-in-2-3-years case for an already ~Rs 5,770 Cr business.
verdict_reasoning: Deep-dive pass 1 resolves the original pass's central open question: valuation. P/E is ~24.3x, and this is now judged against 2 consecutive years of ~44% ROCE (FY25 and FY26, i.e. pre-dating the IPO) plus operating cash flow that exceeds net profit (1.68x FY26) - a genuinely reasonable multiple for this quality, not an unresolved risk.

four_box revised to 4.0 (tailwind yes, tam yes, moat yes - unchanged; valuation upgraded yes given the now-resolved, reasonable P/E against strong ROCE/cash-quality). This is the highest four_box score in this pass's batch.

Despite the strong four_box score, thesis_fit is kept at 'neither' (analyst_override, size/return-magnitude math the mechanical score doesn't capture, parallel to how Carysil and Steelcast were treated earlier this pass) - a market cap of ~Rs 5,770 Cr with a PAT base of ~Rs 193 Cr FY26 does not have a plausible path to a literal 10x in 2-3 years without either extreme profit compounding or an implausible further re-rating; this reads as a strong multi-year compounder, not a return-magnitude special situation.

No red-flag-tier trigger found (no auditor resignation, no promoter pledge, no SEBI/fraud action, no negative-cash-flow-vs-profit pattern like several other names this batch) - conviction reaffirmed at Medium-High rather than downgraded, and arguably the cleanest name reviewed in this pass's expanded batch.
revisit_after_30d not needed - no live, dated event requiring near-term re-check, unlike several other names this pass.
